text: Inside a modern, minimalist space, I feel a sense of anticipation and curiosity. The first image, with its glass-walled room and neatly arranged chairs, gives an impression of quiet professionalism—perhaps a moment just before a meeting or presentation. The second image immerses me in a vibrant, creative environment—a research and development exhibit that celebrates innovation and invites contemplation about the future. I feel both inspired and slightly awed, surrounded by reminders of human progress and possibility.
